newsitem.title: MEXICO: IFC approves $110 mln in funding for BBV-Mexico.
newsitem.headline: IFC approves $110 mln in funding for BBV-Mexico.

text.p: The International Finance Corp said on Monday that it had approved financing worth $110 million for Banco Bilbao Vizcaya-Mexico.
The financing will be made up of a line of credit for restructuring worth $80 million, and a subordinated loan worth $30 million.
The line of credit will allow BBV-Mexico to give financial assistance to allow Mexican companies to restructure their debts, the IFC said.
The IFC said that $10 million is destined to the states of Oaxaca and Chiapas, where this type of financing is scarce.
The subordinated loan represents an influx of capital, and will strengthen the capitalization of BBV-Mexico, it said.
"The loan will be exchangeable for ordinary shares of BBV-Probursa, the parent company of BBV-Mexico, whose shares trade on the Mexican stock exchange," the IFC said.
